content: Tsagdutsaga Yasu ǝn tǝghǝr kǝ pǝcha sǝb
Ka ɗuwars Yasu ad yanen kǝ vak, ka dal da ǝntla khaya Yakhudi, zǝ ghǝdzǝva zagha Urdun. Ka gwidǝn sawala dzakhava udakh da vak sar. A tsagatǝrdu ndǝkve a kwiyalin.
Ka saks kǝ yakhaya kǝ Farisakh da kura kura dǝ ndiɗ. Ka ndiɗarwal itar, “Kalkal nagh tǝkaghǝra kǝ udan zǝ nus sara?”
Ka niya tsitar, “Uɗa tǝkha kurna Musi?”
Ka nǝv itar tsin, “A khayarnǝf Mus ad vindzara kaɗkaɗ pǝcha sǝba kǝ ud, kǝ lakwars lakwa dǝgal.”
Ka nǝv Yasu tsitar, “Tsa wirva ɓengɓeng rǝvakhuɗur, tsa vindza kurkhai Mus adina kǝ ndzikh.”
“Ai gwil farsa vǝrɗ lard, ‘A vǝrɗtǝrkhai Yazhigǝl kǝ zila zǝ nus.’
Wirva yan, ka da ɗuwars udan ad dadsar zǝ babsar kǝ khǝmbarva kǝ nus sar.
Ka mits dagha tara da nǝga kǝ vǝgh kitakul. Aghba itar mits bi, anala kǝ vǝgh kitakul itar.
Wirva yan, dǝge audzala Yazhigǝl ǝn matlanǝf matla, tǝka ba udan bi.”
Gwiyoghǝr tsitar saks da mǝgh, ka ndiɗarwar furakh sar kǝ Yasu ǝn tǝghǝr kǝ tǝkaghǝren.
Ka nggawa tǝrkhai Yasu, “Ɗeghwa ude tǝkaghǝra zǝ nus sar, ka zǝɓu ad tlǝrna nus, gwaragwar ǝn manin zin.
Ai da ka tǝkaghǝra nus zǝ zil sar, ka zǝɓuwin tlǝrna zil, gwaragwar ǝn manin zin.
Zar mbisan zǝ Yasu
Tsǝn zaɓakhado zar mbisan udakh da vak Yasu, kǝ bakhatǝrghǝr dǝv tsin, kǝ batǝrghǝr bark. Ai ka tavatǝrghǝr furakh sar ad di kǝ zaren.
Vazga kǝ Yasu ad dǝge a mangga furakh sar, ka bazala rǝv tsin. Niya tsitar, “Ɗuwamada ɗuwa zar mbisan saks da vakar, gadlamatra bi. Wirva tlǝksa Yazhigǝla, dǝg khutsak tar.
Ən tǝkha kura tǝkha kǝ, itsawar kwal khayanǝf dǝ tlǝksa Yazhigǝl, ndǝkve a khayanǝf zar mbisan, a tǝkh ba kǝ da da tlǝksa Yazhigǝl bi.”
Ka tsakwatrǝf dǝ fang fang, ɓalatǝrghǝr ad dǝv, ka batǝrghǝr ad bark.
Lav ǝn tǝghǝr kǝ dakhwale tluwandal
Tsif kǝ Yasu da ɗuwars yanen kǝ vak, ka khwayoghǝr udanen da vak sar, kǝlgan ad juguv ǝn tǝvuk sar. Ka ndiɗarwal kwarne, “Malǝm charan, uɗa da mana ka kǝ gǝmadu safa kǝ ngǝɗi?”
Ka nǝv Yasu tsin, “Uɗa lava tsǝkhǝn ɗakhka dǝ charani? Na ud charan bi, uk Yazhigǝl kitakul.
Tsa tsǝkha dǝ ndzikha ndzikhen, ai kwarne, ‘Kǝɗ ba safa bi. Man ba gwaragwar bi. A ɗuwa man gǝl. Man ba shida dǝge kwal nǝgha tsǝkha bi. Biɗ ba dǝ ud bi. Farghǝra fǝg kǝ dadagha zǝ babagh.’ ”
Ka nǝv daghwalen tsin, “Malǝm, gwil ǝn zara tsǝka ǝn tsufa tsufa ka dǝgakhan na daghan.”

Ka vazga Yasu dǝ vaza waiv. Niya tsin, “Digit kitakul kǝ khǝtsakhu. Daks sakwdu sakwa daghan dǝge din khǝ, batra kha kwaɓ sar kǝ talagakh. Ka da gǝmadu gǝma kha tluwandal ǝn gharazhigǝl. Tǝkhal kǝ yana ka gataks khǝ.”
Tsǝna kǝ dakhwalen ad lave kwarga Yasu, ka bazala rǝv tsin. Tǝkavala dǝ baza rǝv, wirva nǝg lǝman tsin char.
Ka vazakhga Yasu ad furakh sar, ka niya tsitar, “Da bǝza daks kǝ dadak tluwandal da tlǝksa Yazhigǝl.”
A ndawatǝrǝf kǝ furakh sar, tsǝna tsitar ad lave kwargin. Ai ka nǝv Yasu tsugun, “Zar mbisan nakhar, bǝza daks kǝ ud da tlǝksa Yazhigǝl.
Da lakhlakh kǝ dlǝgwam daks ǝn tǝ ɗul lipǝr, tǝghǝr kǝ daks kǝ dadak tluwandal da tlǝksa Yazhigǝl.”
Tsǝna kǝ furakh sar ad laven, ka gwidǝn ndawatǝrǝf char. Ka nǝv itar ǝn tǝb tar, “Ai da ka ndǝkyanina, war da gǝmadu safa nǝn vak Yazhigǝli?”
Ka vaztǝrkhai Yasu, ka ni, “Ən vak ud dǝg siga ǝn manawa bi, ai ǝn vak Yazhigǝla itsauɗa ǝn manawa man.”
Ka nǝv Bitrus tsin, “Ai kǝnda ma, a ɗuwars kǝnda itsauɗa a gatakhs kǝnd.”

Ka nggawa tǝrkhai Yasu, “Ən tǝkha kura tǝkha kǝ, na ude a ɗuwars fǝta sara, itsa zarbabakh sara, zǝ dǝghaubabakh sar, zǝ bab sar, itsa dad sar, itsa zar sar, awana gukhakh sar, wirva ka, zǝ lav zǝɗan tsugun,

ka piyarwala gǝmadu dǝg siga sar sig dǝrmǝk dǝrmǝk ǝn kwargǝna bi. Da gǝmadu gǝma dǝ mǝghakha, zǝ zarbabakh, zǝ dǝghaubabakh, zǝ babakh, zǝ zar, zǝ gukhakh. Gǝmadu yaken tsuguna khekwa dǝ dlaɗ. Ən kwarge da saks, da gǝmadu gǝma ad safa kǝ ngǝɗ.
Wirva zikǝn liye tsa dǝg chaka, da nǝga itar kǝ dǝg khal. Liye dǝg khal tsuguna, itar da nǝga kǝ dǝg chak.”
Dǝg khǝkǝrɗ ina kǝ Yasu ǝn kwar lavǝn tǝghǝr kǝ ǝmtsa sar

Ən tǝghǝr kǝ ɗul dǝgo da Wurshalim Yasu zǝ furakh sar, Yasu ǝn mǝlatra vuk. Lave tsa kwarga Yasu, ǝn ndawatra ndawa kǝ furakh sar, ka liye ǝn gatatǝrs gata tsuguna ǝn gǝdza itar. Ka gwidǝn ndǝɗtǝraga Yasu kǝ furakh sar na kǝlatǝm mits da tǝ kalam, ka kwara tǝrkhai ad dǝge da dzoghǝr din.

Ka ni, “Tǝkhina ǝn dǝgo da Wurshalim kiyam, da bǝdu bǝgud Zǝr Ud da dǝv kǝ zik zikan na kǝ zil kǝsakh, zǝ li tsagdu ndzikha ndzikh. Da ǝntlara lav ǝmtsud. Ka da barǝm bǝg itar ǝn dǝv kǝ liye kwal Yakhudakh.
Da nenenena itar, zǝ tafarva shaghwvai. Wadzaru itar kiɓa, zǝ kǝɗga kǝɗa tsitar. Ən tǝkhal kǝ khǝna khǝkǝrɗa da tsi.
Takaɗa Yakub zǝ Yukhan ǝn vak Yasu
Ka sagh Yakuba zǝ Yukhan zar ya Zabadi da vak Yasu. Ka nǝv itar, “Malǝm, ǝn na kǝnda mana kǝndkhe kha ɗaga dǝge a takaɗga kǝnd.”
Ka ndiɗatǝrwal Yasu, “Uɗǝn nagh kur mana kurkhai mana tsǝki?”
Ka nggawar khai itar, “Khaya kǝndanǝf khaya ndzǝga ndzǝg tlǝrna udǝnd ǝn tǝ dǝva kafagh, tlǝrna udǝnda tsuguna ǝn tǝ dǝva dleɓagh, ǝn sarte da sǝgdagh khǝn ndangagh.”
Ai ka nǝv Yasu tsitar, “Ən tsa bakur dǝge ǝn takaɗa kur bi, da tǝkha kur kǝ khǝɓga dlaɗe da khǝɓa ka? Awana da khayanǝf khaya khǝ kur ad mana kura para tsud dǝ khulf pare da manakuda?”
Ka nggauga itar, “Da tǝkha kǝnd,” Ka nǝv Yasu tsitar, “Da tǝkha kur kǝ khǝɓga dlaɗe da khǝɓa kǝ, parakuralud dǝ khulf pare a parakadud. ...
Ndzǝgan ǝn tǝ dǝva kafara zǝ dǝva dleɓara, na ka dǝ ndzǝɗa bǝdu bǝg bi. Yan kǝ vakakha dǝg liye audzalud ǝn ɗikatǝrna ɗik.
Tsǝna kǝ chalǝm furakh kǝlɗǝk ad yan kǝ lav, ka bazala rǝv tsitar ǝn tǝghǝr kǝ Yakub zǝ Yukhan.

Ka ɗakh tǝrkhai Yasu da tǝ dǝva kitakw, ka ni, “Tsa tsukur liye a bǝgud kǝ man tlǝks ǝn tǝghǝr kǝ liye kwal Yakhudakh, ǝn mǝdlatra tlǝks itar kǝ udakh tar. Zik zikanakh tar tsuguna ǝn mǝdlatra ndzǝɗe tar.
Da ndǝkyan bǝn tǝbura bi. Ai ɗaga ude ǝn nagh nǝga kǝ zikan ǝn tǝbur, barari tsin nǝga kǝ dadak mana kura tlǝr.
Tsugun ɗaga ude ǝn nagh nǝga kǝ mal ǝn tǝghǝr tsukur, barari tsin nǝga kǝ dadak mana tlǝr kǝ itsawarur.
Wirva itsa ka Zǝr Uda dǝ ghǝrar, a sodagh ba kǝ wirva ɗaba ka ɗaba tsud bi. Ai a sodagh kǝ ɗaba udakh kǝ, zǝ bǝdu safara tsǝka kǝ kat da udakh daghan.
A mbanu Yasu ad ngulf

Khalak yana, ka sagh Yasu zǝ furakh sar da Yariko. Madǝv Yasu zǝ furakh sar zǝ dzakhava udakh zikǝn, ǝn ɗuwars khuɗ kǝs, ka nǝg ngulfen ɗakha sara Batamawus (dǝge ǝn tuku Batamawus na, “Zǝr Timawus.”) Ən ndzǝgan ǝn tǝ kalam ɗul ǝn takaɗ.
Tsǝna tsin kwarne, Yasu ud Nazarat ǝn dǝgal, ka farsa tlǝkha tsin kwarne, “Yasu Zǝr Dod, ziwakdal ziw.”
Zikǝn liye tavarghǝr di kwarne, “Tǝriɗ nikh.” Ai ka gwidǝn tlǝkha tsin char, ǝn kwar kwarne “Zǝr Dod, ziwakdal ziw.”
Ghitsga Yasu, ka ni, “Ɗakhamakdǝghǝr ɗakh.” Ka ɗakhga itar ad ngulfen. Ka nǝv itar tsin, khǝnana rǝvagh, “Tsiyiftsi, ǝn ɗakha ɗakh.” ...
Ka tlǝvars ad lǝgwit sar da tǝ kalam. Ɗǝkut niya ghǝdzǝvǝf, khwayal da vak Yasu.
Ka ndiɗarwal Yasu, “Uɗǝn nakha manakha mana tsǝki? Ka nggawar khai ngulfen, “Malǝm, ǝn na ka nǝgha nǝgh.”
Ka nǝv Yasu tsin, “Dǝg dǝgal, fadǝghǝrofǝgagh kǝ mbakhu.” Tǝvin tǝvina ka ǝn nǝgha nǝgh. Ka gatars kǝ Yasu dǝgal.
